title: ODD rounds away from zero to an odd integer: 1.5 gives 3, 2 gives 3, -1 stays -1, -2 gives -3
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "a", ODD ( 1.5 ), "b", ODD ( 2 ), "c", ODD ( -1 ), "d", ODD ( -2 ) )

source.quote: Rounds -2 up (away from 0) to the nearest odd integer.
source.supports: the table of examples gives 3, 3, -1 and -3 for these four formulas

source.quote: Returns number rounded up to the nearest odd integer.
source.supports: Return values: a single integer value
